comments.author: Scrimshaw
comments.body: I believe Venice only has the one that discovers "Ancient Human Bones" which is a prerequisite for the Ancient clothing map from Amsterdam. It looks like Istanbul has this one and a different Ancient burial map that disco's "Golden Grave Burial Items" mentioned above. The Golden Grave one can also be found in Tunis and Naples. But definitely 2 different maps, both for Egypt North.
